# Simple English Wikipedia

> > Simple English Wikipedia provides accessible encyclopedia articles on geography, economics, science, and general knowledge topics written in simplified English for learners and those seeking clear explanations.

This collaborative encyclopedia uses basic English vocabulary and simpler grammar to make knowledge accessible to English language learners, children, and anyone preferring straightforward explanations. Articles cover diverse topics from physical geography and marine biology to economic concepts and world locations.

## Key Topics

- Geography and landforms
- Peninsulas (Jutland, Baja California, Iberian, Italian, Balkan)
- Economics and markets
- Supply and demand
- Competition and monopoly
- United States locations
- World regions (Europe, Eurasia, South Korea, Singapore, India)
- Physical geography
- Cardinal directions and navigation
- Marine biology
- Free market systems
- Consumer goods and quality
- Disambiguation pages

## Geography and Landforms

- [Peninsula](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peninsula): Geography article on peninsulas with examples like Jutland and Baja
- [South](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/South): Cardinal direction article covering navigation and Southern US regions

## Economics and Business

- [Market](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Market): Economics concept covering supply-demand, competition, and market types
- [Quality](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quality): Product quality concept with Philip Crosby and consumer goods context

## Natural Sciences

- [Pufferfish](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pufferfish): Marine biology article on poisonous pufferfish defense mechanisms

## Locations and Places

- [New York](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York): Disambiguation page for New York state, city, and county locations
